title: SolarMap.PH: open-source rooftop solar detection from satellite imagery
description: Open-source pipeline for detecting rooftop solar photovoltaic installations from high-resolution public satellite imagery over Greater Metro Manila. Combines a frozen CLIP-ViT-L image encoder, a logistic-regression classifier head, Platt-sigmoid probability calibration, and a SAM-based per-building segmentation stage. The shipped classifier is validated at F1 = 0.870 (precision 95.9%, recall 79.7%) on an honest 20% source-disjoint holdout, and the build is bit-exact reproducible from cached embeddings via a deterministic Docker recipe.
